notes: "Survive 100 days" with air as the depleting resource is Survival, and Resource Survival is the preset that matches the loop — gather salvage, craft, expand a base — so I kept its options and only swapped the shape. Its world-biomes shape is wrong twice over: the scale answer keeps everything in one small reachable area around the base, and there is no ground here at all, so I took volume-open-air from the wider catalogue rather than the genre's typical list, since open space with discrete platforms to touch down on (the base, the shop platform, grappled debris) is literally the description. That carries CHECK rather than P0 because movement is genuinely volumetric and a shell of drifting salvage around the base can self-occlude — worth a look before build. The four NPC shopkeepers on their connected platform land on npc-population, not spawner-npc, since the threat answer rules out hostiles; day 100 ends the run on a timer, so no gate-escape, and no separate air-refill geometry was invented beyond the crafting and solar builds the player places themselves.
